verdict.rationale: LangGraph explicitly documents Stores for long-term, cross-thread memory (user preferences, facts, shared knowledge) alongside checkpointer-based short-term thread memory, with production-grade persistence via database backends like PostgresSaver, and GitHub docs describe 'comprehensive memory' spanning both short-term working memory and long-term persistent memory across sessions. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of cross-session/cross-thread store persistence (community commentary only covers general persistence/streaming concerns, not this feature directly).
